name: snyzer
description: Snyzer — AI-assisted writing improvement application (monorepo root).

scripts.build: npm run build -w @snyzer/shared && npm run build -w @snyzer/backend && npm run build -w @snyzer/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @snyzer/shared && npm run typecheck -w @snyzer/shared && npm run typecheck -w @snyzer/backend && npm run typecheck -w @snyzer/frontend
scripts.test:coverage: npm run coverage -w @snyzer/shared && npm run coverage -w @snyzer/backend && npm run coverage -w @snyzer/frontend
